description: The MdnBackend trait (mdn.rs:57-61) defines get_blob_bytes as returning the full Vec<u8> for a blob. parse_mdns (tests/common/mod.rs:2467) calls get_blob_bytes and then immediately applies a cheap header-presence heuristic (line 2478: text.contains("Disposition:")). For a real backend where blobs may include large email attachments, this loads the entire blob into memory before the rejection check. There is no streaming or partial-read interface on the trait. Fix: either (a) add a get_blob_header_bytes(n: usize) method to MdnBackend that fetches only the first N bytes for the quick-reject path, or (b) have parse_mdns implementations check Content-Type from a blob metadata call before fetching bytes. At minimum, document the performance implication in the trait doc so real implementors know they need to guard against large blobs.
title: mdn: MdnBackend::get_blob_bytes forces full load before notParsable check
